Pay with Alipay or WeChat Pay (link an international card before you travel); cash is rarely useful.
Avoid the first three days of Golden Week (early Oct) and the Spring Festival rush if you want quieter paths.
hotel: Base in Guangxi: comfortable 3–4★ hotels typically ¥250–750/night within a taxi ride of the site; book early for weekends and holidays.

name: Lao Shan Shen Pao
hours: 07:00–18:00 (Apr–Oct) · 08:00–17:00 (Nov–Mar); last entry usually 1h before close
hl: Lao Shan Shen Pao（老山神炮）is a visitor attraction in Guangxi, Guangxi — set aside full day for the main circuit.
Best season: Apr–May, Sep–Oct. Arrive within 30 minutes of opening to stay ahead of tour groups.
Expect around ¥80 for the main ticket; peak holidays may sell out — book ahead when caps apply.
